text: The initiative features an end-to-end, user-centered design that integrates space-based extremes monitoring with ground services. It has shifted to dynamic seasonal forecast models and offers multi-timescale products, including weekly to seasonal drought detection. The system employs a novel risk assessment framework that combines hazard, exposure, and vulnerability metrics. It also emphasizes user-centered service design, engaging stakeholders from various sectors to ensure the relevance and actionability of its products.

metadata.solution_name: Climate Risk and Early Warning Systems – Papua New Guinea Drought Early Warning System (CREWS‑PNG)
